g.text: Believe in the Dream — then ship it
CTO at JantraSoft by day, Grand Line code navigator by night.
Pixel-perfect mobile builds in Flutter & Dart with real-time Firebase sync.

Real-time voice intelligence (LiveKit), Groq LLMs & diagnostic health bots.
"People's dreams have no end!" — Marshall D. Teach / Luffy
